Explanation:  
The question asks for the leading scorer of the fifth-place team in the Western Conference two seasons after DeMar DeRozan was traded to the San Antonio Spurs. DeRozan was traded before the 2018-2019 season, so two seasons later would be the 2020-2021 NBA season. In that season, the fifth-place team in the Western Conference was the Dallas Mavericks, and their leading scorer was Luka Dončić. The Predicted Answer incorrectly identifies DeMar DeRozan as the leading scorer for the fifth-place San Antonio Spurs, which is not correct because the Spurs were not the fifth-place team and DeRozan was not the player in question.
